domains.guarded_operator_effect: Constructor selectors establish cache/scale dtype,backend,DCP/offload,EPLB,async valid-count buffers and capture buckets. Repeated ones/zeros are input/bank setup,not repeated model MACs.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Share or fold initialization only under the same mode/shape/dtype/owner/config generation. Preserve selected backend and every dependent buffer or process. ENPU/C8/graph flags cannot be inferred from a kernel name or driver generation.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Method/class selection determines draft width,auxiliary layers and target-hidden demand. DSpark,Eagle3,extract,other-model branches have distinct consumers; nonempty per-method lists and PP rank matter.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Target-tail pruning or shared target/draft work is conditional on actual demand and parameter/input generations. Preserve alternative selector bodies and errors; a text label DSpark alone is not a Qwen3 layout or an auxiliary-reader certificate.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Graph dispatch combines compile/breakable/enforce-eager modes; unwrap follows actual wrapper type. Temporary cuda/event/stream/weakref and SP pass bindings are restored in finally,including errors.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Keep wrapper dispatch and restore boundaries. A proposed body fusion may preserve the existing public interface; an address/update/offload rewrite needs its exact captured-bank/native contract. Stable descriptor or weak reference does not establish generation/lifetime.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Producer-only PD is producer and not consumer; no-forward connector work may still transfer/publish cache state.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: No local model rows does not imply no connector/peer/cache work. Preserve role-dependent completion and ownership before any producer/defer/reuse transformation.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Async PP consumers remap previous request IDs,discarded rows,valid output lengths and new sampled IDs before appending state. Empty-token and missing-previous-request cases differ.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fuse row remap/gather/copy only against one immutable old snapshot or an explicit dependency-safe schedule. Equal batch size cannot identify request rows; keep output-token,token-is-ID and no-spec-count updates.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: State update may copy KV blocks,clear newly assigned blocks,repair draft lengths on rollback and incorporate PP sampled IDs. These precede input/model work.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A combined copy/clear kernel must preserve original ordering,overlap/source snapshots and block generations. Elide a zero only if overwritten before every read; no independence from different field names or one absent trace connection.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Accepted counts,previous-to-current request maps and async events are separate from optional hybrid/Mamba align/all state copies. New requests receive explicit defaults; valid output IDs use the original -1 predicate.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Combine summaries/remaps only with original signed comparison,cast/overflow,bounds and source epochs. Temp0 or shape equality does not remove accepted-count events. Current exported mamba mode none narrows its own comparisons,not all hidden state effects.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Input preparation derives exact ordered request/token counts,old positions/accepted corrections,logits indices,discard masks,slot maps and optional embeds/LoRA. CP rebuilt/positions-ready flags can suppress only the corresponding producers.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fuse snapshot-to-bank construction and small copies under final consumer strides/dtypes,valid/padded extents and copy-ready edges. Keep actual CP cache-hit generation; do not execute a cached dead producer merely for fusion,or infer cache equality from stable addresses.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Decode/prefill/speculative state depends on actual scheduled and valid counts. Placeholder -1 sanitization occurs on the guarded continuation. FIA start-location padding may append a real final endpoint and copy the bank.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fold ID sanitization into the final input producer only if all Engram/router/model/raw-ID readers see the same cleaned prefix. Preserve ordered per-request offsets and padded-tail endpoints; bucket reduction needs a new packing contract,not just fewer allocated tokens.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Speculative cumulative counts/logits-index planes are distinct arrays; CPU/device branches,pinned owners,pending-copy queues,events and optimistic sequence-length correction define their current epoch.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: One producer or transfer may emit their combined final representation only with matching consumer ABI and per-field dtype/extent. Source staging owners survive asynchronous DMA; old reader AND queued writer retirement are required. Do not remove a synchronize without the equivalent readiness proof.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Drafter dispatch selects tensor/list,packed/padded,method-specific ID/hidden/position inputs and optional probability planes. Fits/skip branches can still prepare next IDs,copy counts or run peer-required dummy forward.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Keep method-specific query width and request namespace,all auxiliary/KV/state demands and DP participation. A skipped local proposal is not global zero receiver work. Confidence/probability or target-hidden pruning is a separate observer guard.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Logging/debugger guards affect type/shape/data observation and start/step/stop state; disabled guards and active dump sessions are different domains.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Retain the original observer guard and cleanup. Body fusion does not require research of arbitrary logging internals; deleting a content bank requires any enabled observer in its read set. No gain is credited for an already disabled observer.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Host draft-ID transport depends on structured output/token-history/PP need,zeros_only,available streams/events,valid widths and dynamic per-request K clipping.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Batch transfers/notifications only with original per-request ID order and valid prefixes. A zero-only shortcut cannot silently remove grammar/history/PP consumers. Retain staging/event lifetime and parent-result normalization.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Execute owns no-token/connector/encoder paths,authoritative state snapshot and CP/PP/cascade/padded mode choices; it then prepares metadata/model inputs,forwards,selects demanded hidden rows/heads and releases metadata/KV publication. Deferred corrections and external-launch alignment remain ordered.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A rewritten subgraph must preserve these operator release/read/write effects. No-scheduled-token branches may still do connector/dummy work. Tail demand cannot drop prompt logprobs,auxiliary,KV/EPLB or intermediate PP outputs. Do not introduce whole-operator waits from a chosen tile or claim host gaps are free device overlap.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Sampling guards select grammar processing,logits conversion/transport,rejection versus ordinary sampler,padded drafting and PP output,accepted state and stream events. Existing rejection and processor order precedes result publication.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fuse public score selection after the same final processed score values; retain earlier raw/entropy/logprob/RNG/error readers. Replacing a grammar CPU round trip needs exact bitmask/dtype/rounding and observer semantics. Cross-iteration next-ID preparation cannot precede its accepted/current snapshot.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Optional NaN counting/raise paths can read logits and synchronize even when ordinary returned logprobs are absent.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: If enabled,retain the same stage/dtype count and error behavior or fold that exact check into its producer. Low ratio/temperature/request-logprob absence does not prove this observer disabled.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Bookkeeping distinguishes async,one-token versus rejection output,invalid/discarded requests,logprobs,prompt logprobs,NaN diagnostics and generator-offset rollback; it appends real IDs and publishes the next previous-request map.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A result/summary kernel may share a scan but must preserve valid-ID predicates,per-request ID order,RNG offsets and all old/new owner fields. Empty IDs and skipped requests have state semantics; no unqualified summary reuse across iterations.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Engram inputs use selected layer/group and current forward metadata/block table; missing layer/metadata returns a different input domain.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Lookup/prefetch/reuse keys include selected IDs,positions,layer/table/parameter/cache generations and owner. Stable slot or same head shapes do not establish identity; preserve current lookback/rollback state.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: A metadata executor is relevant only when submission is in flight; FULL graph execution requires the supported external-event protocol and may otherwise raise.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Producer/consumer fusion may replace this boundary only with equivalent readiness and the declared successful ABI domain. Never replace unknown in-flight state by ready merely because buffers exist.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Intermediate banks are per key,may be allocated when missing,and copy/view different extents under SP and sync_self.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Share/fold copy with a producer only after exact row-owner/stride/source-generation and original overlap rules. Distinct dictionary keys can alias; pointer stability is not the read-ready or lifetime proof.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Fused-copy offload metadata may require eager tail restoration across dict/list groups before later consumers.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Cache-state and tail-restoration work cannot disappear just because the main producer is fused or a local query set is empty. Any deferred/COW path retains every needed tail and queue/publication epoch.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Metadata construction spans request/token padding,CPU snapshots or views,per-group block/slot tables,DCP/GDN,common V41/C2 data,offload/tail restore,vision/audio ranges,microbatches and device-task submission. Drafter common metadata must be selected from its own group.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fuse/share equivalent fields from one authoritative snapshot using the exact group/ratio/layer/owner/state/config key and compatible output banks. Existing common-metadata caches are baseline,not new work savings. A dtype/shape-only key or final scalar count misses row/position/table/RNG epochs. Preserve active device-task producers and release events.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: DCP metadata selects disabled,dummy,async corrected or CPU-length domains,with distinct local/global row coordinates.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Do not equate PCP,DCP,TP or SP groups by similar names. Repartition requires exact global-to-local map,valid padded requests and current sequence-length epoch; unchanged selectors preserve alternative branches.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Encoder-only creates its own slot representation; ordinary groups use current block-table and slot banks and fill request/token padding with their original constants.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A combined final writer may fold clears only if it fully defines every consumed tail in the correct dtype and map. Different fields/padding constants are not a common zero plane; preserve table validity and cache generations.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Builder class,capture mode,group/microbatch and actual request extents choose build versus capture-build,common V41 ratio metadata,per-layer aliases and optional device metadata tasks. GDN no-op changes the valid domain.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Same-ratio reuse must include every effective builder input and output-generation/alias contract,not ratio alone. Fold a public builder pipeline under an unchanged descriptor rather than editing unidentified native helpers; all publication tasks remain represented.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Heat collection uses configured stage and maximum cross-DP padded tokens where present; local row zero is not the phase decision.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Preserve expert/load/parameter ownership updates when scheduling/fusing dispatch. Do not reuse counters across layers or steps solely because launch capacity is unchanged.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Model/draft/LoRA loading,aux-layer selection,lookback buffers,lim-indexer owner binding,wrapper capture options and update streams establish identities for later sharing. Shared parameter/data_ptr ownership is a construction fact,not all-reader equivalence.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Reuse only under unchanged parameter/layout/quantization/config generations and selected model ABI. Startup warmup/weight preparation is not repeated serving MAC work. All temporary selection patches and errors remain outside the rewritten kernel body.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: KV initialization applies the layerwise plan,binds physical views/aliases and registration,selects per-group kernel block sizes,validates draft group compatibility and prepares ratio2 compressor rings.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A shared/fused cache producer keeps all consumer physical layouts and bank epochs. Changing a layout or accepted-input publication requires updating every bound native consumer; allocation identity or sorted layer name does not establish independent storage.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Spec selection covers V41/cache-only/MLA/indexer/full/hybrid,compressed or page-strided layouts,sparse C4/C8/MXFP/TQ scale planes,sharing and block padding. dtype auto is unresolved until its selected spec/backend.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Treat the complete descriptor as a typed contract:base owner,byte offsets,layer/block/page strides,capacity,logical positions,all value/scale types and aliases. No universal necessary bytes from a table/checkpoint/workspace size,and no INT8 KV or BF16 mode from W8A8 model naming.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Quantized allocation requires positive sizes,alignment/contiguity and proper scale views. MXFP value-scale initialization and block reset can encode a scale different from raw all-zero bytes; KV-transfer presence changes allocation behavior.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Fuse initialization or reset only with a final full writer preserving data AND encoded scale planes,all touched blocks and original copy/read order. Reinterpreting INT8 backing as scale dtype requires byte alignment/extent proofs; row zeros do not imply dead scale initialization.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Descriptor regions and reused layer slots,combined or separate K/V/scale/tuple buffers,page/byte padding,strided backing,hybrid state and packed/offload modes produce different physical views. Bounds/alignment/type/extent guards and raw-object alias tests constrain construction.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: A legal relayout is a consistent mapping of all live views and observers. Preserve output types,byte/element unit conversions,offset/page/layer strides,tuple ordering,scale encoding and valid padding; physical memory/traffic counts union shared backing once. Shared backing never licenses merging unrelated epochs,or treating allocated padding as useful work. Prefix/COW/reuse needs complete selected view generations and queued-reader/writer retirement.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Multiple cache groups/kernel block sizes and offload/speculation settings may replace the input-batch object and its per-request bank capacities.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Treat a replacement as a new ownership/config generation even if allocator addresses recur. Cached metadata/graph updates must preserve current bank bindings; no pointer-only ABA reuse.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Per-layer backend/spec keys and integer-versus-MultipleOf kernel block support choose groups/builders and provider IDs. Device metadata executor enables actual providers,not every vaguely similar backend.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Group fusion/reuse requires compatible builder outputs and exact block/rope/cache layout,not class-name similarity. Preserve unsupported-size errors and mode compatibility; provider identity is not a ready/event certificate.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: Optional encoder/CPU/offload caches have request reference sets,temporary/promoted ownership,pinned copies,pending events and field-specific CPU/device placement. Early-return guards still control later unconditional copy or cleanup effects.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Preserve actual text-versus-multimodal input contract and all request/hash/parameter keys. Batch transfers may share submission but retain source objects until DMA completes and all refcount/event retirement. Missing MM work in a profile is not global unreachability; no reuse across distinct normalizations/hash namespaces.

domains.guarded_operator_effect: TYPE_CHECKING chooses type-only imports versus runtime lazy-loader setup.
domains.fusion_split_reorganization_answer_and_c: Keep module import/selector behavior unchanged; it adds no claimed model-kernel fusion or runtime MAC savings.
